spec_fidelity: The title, gold indicator, and four required menu actions are present, but the requested atmospheric hero area is reduced to a small generic cyan orb surrounded by empty black space, so it does not visibly establish spirit summoning.
unity: Gold title and accents, dark cards, and centered symmetry are coherent, yet the cyan orb belongs to a different visual language and the enormous unstructured gap separates title, hero, and navigation rather than binding them into one mystical scene.
variety: The four menu cards are nearly identical and the hero contains only one simple effect; there is little difference between the primary Summon action and secondary destinations beyond a thin border.
conflict: Unity favors restrained symmetry and a limited mystical palette, while Variety needs a memorable summoning focal event and clearer primary-versus-secondary menu roles; Fidelity requires the hero to become substantive rather than merely decorative.
resolution: Build one coherent ritual language—gold, teal spirit light, concentric sigils, smoke, and shared angular ornament—then vary scale and intensity only for the central spirit and primary Summon action.
moderator_revision: Transform the empty center into a substantive atmospheric summoning hero: create a large translucent spirit silhouette emerging from a luminous ritual seal with concentric glyph rings, wisps, particles, and restrained teal-to-gold light. Pull the title, hero, currency, and menu into a tighter vertical composition connected by the same fine-line occult ornament. Preserve one dark mystical palette and consistent card geometry, but make Summon the dominant larger or brighter primary card with unique sigil treatment while keeping Roster, Battle, and Grind quieter yet distinct through semantically appropriate icons. Avoid adding unrelated colors or decorative motifs.
